text.en: Accounts and other statistics pertaining to Government Corporations and undertakings, Public and Private Limited Companies, partnerships, proprietorships, associations and societies including cooperative societies; and

Household income and expenditure. Appointment of Competent Officer under section 4 (1) ·' The Minister has appointed the Chief Statistician in the Ministry of S.55177 Finance, to be the Competent Officer for the purpose of collecting statistics directed by the Minister from time to time. B. L. R. 0. 111984
